## Custom models for Claude Code
- **Memory:** Custom models now save and recall local memory, both during a turn and in the background after it. Background and helper work runs on your custom model too. - **claude.ai connectors, plugins and skills:** If you're signed in to claude.ai, custom models can use your connectors, plugins and skills. Inference still goes to your own endpoint with its own credentials. - **Resume:** Conversations on third-party models (custom endpoints, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry) resume reliably instead of failing a session check.
## Tool search
- **Per account:** Each provider account has a switch for deferred tool loading. With it on, Controller's tools load only when the agent searches for them, which saves context. This works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode and Grok. - **Per custom model:** Turn off tool search for an endpoint that doesn't support it, and that model gets the tools loaded directly. Set this on the Mac or on iPhone and iPad.
## Fixed
- Steering a running turn uses the thread's current permissions, keeps your draft attachments, and no longer drops queued prompts if the turn ends at the same moment. - Connect hosts no longer stall at startup while a still-valid certificate is near renewal. - Remote devices can create threads and terminals only in folders they're allowed to browse, or in existing projects and worktrees. - Browser uploads refuse protected credential folders whatever the letter case. - Opening a pull request's checkout from the sidebar moves the thread correctly, and commit message previews no longer touch the Git index. - Fixes for Claude Code tool calls from code and server tools showing up in the transcript, Pi sessions losing Controller tools when another Pi thread closes, Mermaid diagram crash recovery, iPhone approval cards after a submission, and several memory leaks in the browser.

## Custom models for Claude Code
- **Code Mode per model:** Each custom model has a Code Mode (programmatic tool calling) switch. When it is on, Claude Code runs tools from code on its own, and those calls show cleanly in the transcript. When it is off, the code tools stay unavailable to that model. - **Parallel tool calls per model:** Turn off parallel tool calls for an endpoint that can't handle them, and Claude Code runs one tool at a time. The model list marks these models "Serial tools". - Both switches are on the Mac and on iPhone and iPad. Switching between models with different settings restarts Claude Code and resumes the same conversation.
## Fixed
- A Claude Code account that uses custom models no longer signs in with claude.ai, pulls in claude.ai connectors, plugins or skills, or lists the built-in Claude models. Its model picker shows only your custom models. - Custom models compact the conversation at their own configured context window instead of a remote setting.

## Agents and models
- **Custom models for Claude Code:** A Claude Code account can now add its own models from any Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint, such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter or a Gemini proxy. Give each one a slug, display name, endpoint, API key (kept in the Keychain), custom headers, context window, output limit, auto-compact threshold and reasoning support, and choose which model subagents use. Add, edit and delete them on the Mac or from iPhone and iPad, and pick them in the model picker like any other model. - **Visualizations in the transcript:** When an agent replies with a `<json-render>` block, Controller draws it in place on the Mac and iPhone: cards, tables, lists, bar charts, sparklines, progress bars, metrics, callouts, timelines and more, with a placeholder while the block is still streaming. - **Antigravity subagents stay in their lane:** Tool calls from an Antigravity subagent no longer end or interrupt the parent chat's message or reasoning, and starting a subagent is no longer mistaken for its final reply.
## Terminals and files on your other Macs
- **Terminals look like the Mac's:** A terminal on another Mac now shows its real colors, cursor and font size instead of plain text, on the Mac and on iPhone and iPad. - **A new iPhone terminal:** Type straight into the terminal in a full sheet, switch tabs with larger touch targets, and use a shortcut strip above the keyboard. Scrollback you are reading stays put while new output arrives. - **Documents from another Mac:** PDF, RTF, Office and iWork files in a remote checkout open with Quick Look on the Mac and on iPhone and iPad. - **Text files open again:** Code, Markdown, JSON and plain-text files from another Mac load again. On iPhone, Markdown has the Mac's formatted and source views, links between documents open inside the checkout, and long code lines scroll sideways instead of being cut off.
## Faster and steadier
- Conversations load and save with less work, and the sidebar and pull request list update faster in large workspaces. - Opening sign-in pages and links, reading your Controller account at launch, and starting up no longer pause the interface. - Typing in the iPhone composer no longer searches commands and files on every keystroke.
## Fixed
- Markdown tables that arrived on a single line show as tables again on the Mac and iPhone. - A crash in an agent's command-line tool or a shell is no longer reported as a Controller crash. - A crash on iPhone when background refresh started or ran out of time. - Spurious protocol warnings from Grok and Claude Code housekeeping messages.
